description: This file defines the 'View' class within the MPF\Core namespace, responsible for rendering view templates and managing associated data in a PHP MVC-like framework.

classes.name: View
classes.description: A class providing methods to load, render, and manage view templates and their data in a PHP application.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a View object with a specified view template, checking for its existence.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the static data array for use in views.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value associated with a key from the static data array.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Loads and displays a specified view template, capturing its output.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the stored view template with the accumulated data, outputting its content.
